scope: Catalog of local component definitions and variant sets on all current pages; includes IDs, keys, names, descriptions, dimensions, exposed property definitions, variant values and default variants. Does not include child layer trees or external library catalogs.

items.name: Layout
items.description:
Layout is the main frame of a view.
Use Layout as the root component when creating a new view or screen.
Do not place Layout inside another Layout.
Build the main structure in this order: Layout → Component → Card → content elements.
Place the main content of the view inside the Card.
Use Container inside the Card to organize and group content elements.

items.name: Card
items.description:
Start building every new component with Card.
Do not place a Card inside another Card.
Card provides the outer padding for the component.
Set width to Fill by default.
Set height to Hug by default.

items.name: Container
items.description:
Containerarranges its content vertically or horizontally.
Place Containerinside a Component.
Place other UI elements inside Container.
Use Containerto group related content and controls.
Do not use Containeras the root element of a new component; use Component as the root instead.

items.name: Text
items.description:
Use sm for regular body text.
Use lg / bold for headings.
Use lg / bold only when the text serves as a 
heading or title.
Otherwise, prefer sm for text content.
Set width to Fill by default.
Set height to Hug by default.
